	potential = {

			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			has_or_had_tag = ELR
			has_or_had_tag = ANC
			has_societal_value = societal_value_type:latinization_vs_hellenization
		}
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:mos_maiorum }
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_towards_hellenization = societal_value_large_monthly_move
		cultural_tradition_modifier = 0.10
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = 0.05
		tolerance_own = 0.5
		diplomatic_spending_cost = 0.05
	}

	on_activate = {
		oe_v430_apply_rhomanismos_language = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		if = {
			limit = { court_language = language:greek_language }
			add = 30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { religion ?= religion:orthodox }
			add = 20
		}
	}

	years = 2
}

oe_v430_ref_latin_liturgical_rite = {
	age = age_1_traditions

	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			has_or_had_tag = ELR
			has_or_had_tag = ANC
			has_societal_value = societal_value_type:latinization_vs_hellenization
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			court_language = language:latin_language
			has_reform = government_reform:mos_maiorum
		}
		NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_v430_ref_rhomanismos_hellenic_court }
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_towards_latinization = societal_value_monthly_move
		legislative_efficiency = 0.08
		tolerance_heretic = 1.0
		global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = 0.10
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.04
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = { religion ?= religion:catholic }
			set_liturgical_language = dialect:church_dialect
		}
		else = {
			set_liturgical_language = dialect:roman_dialect
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { religion ?= religion:catholic }
				NOT = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion }
				NOT = { court_language = language:latin_language }
			}
			add = -200
		}
		if = {
			limit = { religion ?= religion:catholic }
			add = 35
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
				court_language = language:latin_language
			}
			add = 30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_or_had_tag = ANC }
			add = 25
		}
	}

	years = 2
}
